description: Curated 3-role legal-ops team — paralegal intake, in-house counsel reference, and internal-audit advisor coordinated under one coordination protocol. High-stakes domain with baked-in disclaimers (not-a-lawyer, no attorney-client privilege, never signs off on controls), structured handoffs (intake → counsel for advice, intake → auditor for SOX/SOC2/process compliance, counsel → auditor on material weakness discovered during contract review), and PII flow gated through agent-base:privacy. Composes agent-base:tangle, agent-base:secure, agent-base:privacy, agent-output:blocks. The team substrate above three single-role legal/audit families.

buildHints.whenToUse: When the product is a coordinated 3-role legal-ops team — paralegal intake triages requests and routes to in-house counsel for contract advice or to internal audit for SOX/SOC2/process compliance. Use when the user asks for a 'legal-ops team', 'compliance team agent', 'legal and audit pod', or describes a workflow that spans intake + advisory + audit. For a single role, prefer agent-runtime-legal-counsel-ts or agent-runtime-auditor-ts.
firstSteps: Read AGENTS.md — orchestrator prompt + Coordination section defines the request flow (intake first, then counsel OR auditor).
Each role has an AGENTS.md with mandatory disclaimers. Do NOT remove the disclaimer block.
PII flowing through any role passes agent-base:privacy redaction before persistence — see src/lib/privacy/.
Default respondent is paralegal-intake; counsel and auditor are reachable only via documented hand-offs.
gotchas: Nothing in this team has attorney-client privilege. Every paralegal-intake session must surface this on first turn.
The auditor never signs off on controls — drafts only; a credentialed CIA/CISA reviews and signs.
Counsel → auditor hand-off fires when contract review surfaces a material weakness in the counterparty's or client's ICFR; do not silently work around it.
Roles share PII redaction primitives but DO NOT share state — each role keeps its own session log.
architectureNotes: Bundle layout: AGENTS.md (orchestrator + Coordination section) + agents.json (OpenCode-native subagent registry with inline prompts) + roles/<role>/AGENTS.md + roles/<role>/methodology/*.md.

agents.json is consumed by the Tangle sandbox sidecar (apps/sidecar/src/agents/subagents/load-agents-config.ts) to register subagents. disclaimerRequired=true and stakes=high are read at session-start to surface disclaimers.
Composes with agent-base:privacy because every role handles client PII; with agent-output:blocks for :::artifact / :::escalation / :::question / :::filing block emission.
